verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Inference Providers for chat completion and image/video generation through a single API, but never mentions an embeddings (feature-extraction) task or a reranking capability. The only related item downloads a sentence-transformers model file. That is a developer building block for running embeddings yourself, not a documented embedding or rerank service, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
